notes: All 30 source and 41 target ids partitioned once.

Both articles in הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה are `unrepresented` because the ASV writes *these cities* with no *the* for the phrase at all — rule 29's final clause, and rule 47 does not apply since there is no English *the* to assign to a first article.
The object suffix of אֶתְהֶם is resumptive of אֲשֶׁר, which already takes *which*; keeping it as its own `unrepresented` unit rather than folding it in follows rule 22.
The three-level מַטֵּה בְנֵי PN chains carry no article morpheme, so both written *the*s are supplied on the constructs (rule 29).
